title: Functions on Nilpotent Orbit Covers and Birational Geometry
summary: We use an analogue of the Springer resolution to describe the $G$-module structure on the ring of regular functions on the universal cover $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}$ of any nilpotent orbit for $G = SL_n$. Building on previous work on the extended Springer resolution, we construct a variety $\widetilde{\mathcal{M}}$ that is finite over the cotangent bundle of a partial flag variety $G/P$, and proper and birational over the affinization $\mathcal{M}$ of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}$.
